adapter.read: platform/data/atlas/data.json (compiled from each component's newest runs/system-integration/components-<c>/<run>/flow.json); an issue is open when it has no resolved and no merged_into
adapter.still_true: a component's next system run re-reads every issue (SCHEMA §5a); between runs, triage marks 'looks fixed' with evidence and the triage owner closes it
adapter.write_back: SCHEMA §5a: a close sets resolved (evidence) and resolved_by; every later run carries both; a run that contradicts it raises a conflict for the triage owner
adapter.reopen_gap: missing: proposed that an undo record clears resolved and notes who reopened it and why (to the lead with the record-kind card)
adapter.code: today inside tools/triage_dryrun.py; to be extracted as the atlas adapter

where: the issue in its component's flow (runs from 6838d3556 on)
triage/issue-briefs/<component>.json (ATL-27 (P0 P1 issue briefs), until each component's next run)
summary.coverage_2026_10_02: met: all 656 open issues (ATL-31 (remaining issue briefs)) and all 83 actions (60 built by tools/triage_fill.py); the 29 that look fixed close instead
summary.fill_policy: targeted: each component's issues gain the parts on its next system run (the team 01:08Z 'Targeted'); a bulk fill of the 302 that need someone else is held for the team

at_creation.rule: every item, action group or issue this theme's triage creates carries all eight parts when it is created; never backfilled
at_creation.ruled: the team, 2026-10-02, received 06:43Z by date -u: "also starting from now make it a rule that anything issues that come from this triage process should geneate with the 8 step summary from the start"

summary.fix_means: the response: what to do, whether a fix, a follow-up on a positive signal, or another move. Key kept as `fix` for compatibility; shown as Response (the team, 2026-10-02)

categories: Docs say one thing, code another
categories_note: called 'theme' in tools/triage_dryrun.py; renamed 'category' so it does not clash with a triage theme
cause_classes_note: the most used of the 2026-10-02 dry run's patterns (clusters-2026-10-02.json); each names a mechanism, and items sharing one usually clear in one action

rules.name: close-out
rules.when: the issue looks already fixed (the cited file or README fill shows it)
rules.group_by: one action for all of them

rules.name: shared fix
rules.when: the same fix applies across components (one cause class with an action-shaped name, e.g. repoint moved paths, README how-to link line)

rules.name: decision group
rules.when: the issue waits on one specific ruling

grouping.why: the red-test back-test showed real fixes land in batches by person, not only by shared cause; a local batch is one sitting for one owner

tiers.P0: touches a wall, or says one thing and does another on a component that runs
tiers.P1: blocks or breaks something on a component in use (>20 runs, or ≥3 dependents, or runs we cannot see)
tiers.P3: parked: ≤20 runs, fewer than 3 dependents, no runs we cannot see

priority.live_use_for_p0: ruled (#6, 4b36a7a90): a run on record within 30 days, a grant on the mini, or a person's live use; keywords may propose a P0, never assign one; the check is not built
priority.severity_source: the issue's summary severity where present (192), else the keyword tier

age.why_not: atlas issues carry no open-since date yet

owners.source: components/CLAUDE.md Residents table, then each component's CLAUDE.md
disputed_2026_10_02: email-production#5: data says the team, the register row says the owner
qc-checks#9 and #12: data says the team; the team owns the qc-checks engine since 2026-10-01
local-studio and 3d: no owner on record
brandpath: the owner inferred from commit authorship

walls: a machine delete or external send
media over the size limit in git
brands/ read-only to machines this phase

now: changes no owner, contract or curated content (content the triage owner curates is theirs)

option_3.adds: a ruled default, or a fix the brief already spells out, in an owner's component, with the owner told rather than asked
limits: the brief names the change and a test proves it
no test assertion weakened or removed
nothing changes how a live pipeline behaves
every change is a decision-log record with a one-line undo; owners see their areas' changes there
logged first: the record and context line exist before the change lands

doer_tags.now: the triage owner can do it alone, today, within the lane conditions
doer_tags.after: the triage owner can do it once a ruling lands (the action's own, or the pending 'apply a ruled default, owner told' ruling)
doer_tags.draft: the triage owner prepares it; the owner lands it (owner's work in flight, a live path, or large)
doer_tags.owner: only the owner can do it (a design call, knowledge or an act only they have)

context_hook.limits: last 30 days, at most ~15 one-line entries; structured fields only
context_hook.works: sessions started at the workspace root
context_hook.misses: sessions started inside the component folder

routes.makers: cards drafted by the triage owner, dispatched by the lead
routes.glm: tests-only and single-file doc cards (decision log 2026-09-17); issue summaries pending the TI-24 (red-test summaries GLM) evaluation
routes.claude: everything else; the owner's chains stay on Claude

open_gaps: the adapter is still inside tools/triage_dryrun.py
lane conditions and Option 3 not ruled
the context hook not ruled; 44 component instructions files to sign
blocked_by: a card awaiting approval, a pending decision, or nothing (the team 'ok' on #3, 4b36a7a90); filled by the core's cause pass
